title: Happy otter
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- water backdrop -->
  <rect x='5' y='72' width='90' height='20' rx='10' fill='#1a5276'/>
  <rect x='5' y='72' width='90' height='6' rx='3' fill='#2e86c1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='15' ry='12' fill='#d4a76a'/>
  <!-- left arm -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='62' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#7a4a1e' transform='rotate(20 28 62)'/>
  <!-- right arm -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='62' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#7a4a1e' transform='rotate(-20 72 62)'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='20' ry='18' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='47' rx='12' ry='8' fill='#d4a76a'/>
  <!-- left ear -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='26' r='5' fill='#7a4a1e'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='26' r='3' fill='#c97b4a'/>
  <!-- right ear -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='26' r='5' fill='#7a4a1e'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='26' r='3' fill='#c97b4a'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='37' r='4' fill='#1c1c2e'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='37' r='4' fill='#1c1c2e'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='36' r='1.5' fill='#a8e6ff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='36' r='1.5' fill='#a8e6ff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='43.5' rx='1.5' ry='1' fill='#5a4a3a'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 48 Q50 54 56 48' stroke='#3a2a1a' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='36' y1='45' x2='26' y2='43' stroke='#c9a06a' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='36' y1='47' x2='26' y2='48' stroke='#c9a06a' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='64' y1='45' x2='74' y2='43' stroke='#c9a06a' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='64' y1='47' x2='74' y2='48' stroke='#c9a06a' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks blush -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='44' r='3' fill='#e8836a' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='44' r='3' fill='#e8836a' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- tail hint -->
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='78' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#7a4a1e' transform='rotate(-15 78 78)'/>
  <!-- water ripples -->
  <path d='M15 82 Q25 78 35 82 Q45 86 55 82 Q65 78 75 82 Q85 86 95 82' stroke='#5dade2' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
